items.originalEnglish: I am clear what is expected of me at work
items.workingChinese: 我清楚工作中对我的要求。

items.originalEnglish: I can decide when to take a break
items.workingChinese: 我可以决定什么时候休息一下。

items.originalEnglish: Different groups at work demand things from me that are hard to combine
items.workingChinese: 工作中不同群体对我的要求很难兼顾。

items.originalEnglish: I know how to go about getting my job done
items.workingChinese: 我知道该怎样完成自己的工作。

items.originalEnglish: I am subject to personal harassment in the form of unkind words or behaviour
items.workingChinese: 我遭受到针对个人的骚扰，例如不友善的言语或行为。

items.originalEnglish: I have unachievable deadlines
items.workingChinese: 我被要求在无法做到的期限内完成工作。

items.originalEnglish: If work gets difficult, my colleagues will help me
items.workingChinese: 如果工作遇到困难，同事会帮助我。

items.originalEnglish: I am given supportive feedback on the work I do
items.workingChinese: 我所做的工作能得到支持性的反馈。

items.originalEnglish: I have to work very intensively
items.workingChinese: 我不得不以很高的强度工作。

items.originalEnglish: I have a say in my own work speed
items.workingChinese: 对于自己的工作速度，我有发言权。

items.originalEnglish: I am clear what my duties and responsibilities are
items.workingChinese: 我清楚自己的工作职责。

items.originalEnglish: I have to neglect some tasks because I have too much to do
items.workingChinese: 因为要做的事情太多，我不得不忽略某些任务。

items.originalEnglish: I am clear about the goals and objectives for my department
items.workingChinese: 我清楚所在部门的目标。

items.originalEnglish: There is friction or anger between colleagues
items.workingChinese: 同事之间存在摩擦或愤怒情绪。

items.originalEnglish: I have a choice in deciding how I do my work
items.workingChinese: 我可以选择怎样开展自己的工作。

items.originalEnglish: I am unable to take sufficient breaks
items.workingChinese: 我无法获得充分的休息。

items.originalEnglish: I understand how my work fits into the overall aim of the organisation
items.workingChinese: 我理解自己的工作如何配合组织的总体目标。

items.originalEnglish: I am pressured to work long hours
items.workingChinese: 我受到压力，需要长时间工作。

items.originalEnglish: I have a choice in deciding what I do at work
items.workingChinese: 我可以选择自己在工作中做什么。

items.originalEnglish: I have to work very fast
items.workingChinese: 我不得不非常快速地工作。

items.originalEnglish: I am subject to bullying at work
items.workingChinese: 我在工作中受到欺凌。

items.originalEnglish: I have unrealistic time pressures
items.workingChinese: 我承受着不切实际的时间压力。

items.originalEnglish: I can rely on my line manager to help me out with a work problem
items.workingChinese: 遇到工作问题时，我可以依靠直属主管提供帮助。

items.originalEnglish: I get help and support I need from colleagues
items.workingChinese: 我能从同事那里得到所需要的帮助和支持。

items.originalEnglish: I have some say over the way I work
items.workingChinese: 对于自己的工作方式，我有一定发言权。

items.originalEnglish: I have sufficient opportunities to question managers about change at work
items.workingChinese: 关于工作中的变动，我有充分机会向管理者提问。

items.originalEnglish: I receive the respect at work I deserve from my colleagues
items.workingChinese: 我在工作中受到同事应有的尊重。

items.originalEnglish: Staff are always consulted about change at work
items.workingChinese: 工作发生变动时，总会征求员工的意见。

items.originalEnglish: I can talk to my line manager about something that has upset or annoyed me about work
items.workingChinese: 对于工作中让我难过或烦恼的事情，我可以与直属主管交谈。

items.originalEnglish: My working time can be flexible
items.workingChinese: 我的工作时间可以灵活安排。

items.originalEnglish: My colleagues are willing to listen to my work-related problems
items.workingChinese: 同事愿意倾听我与工作有关的问题。

items.originalEnglish: When changes are made at work, I am clear how they will work out in practice
items.workingChinese: 工作发生变动时，我清楚这些变动将如何实际开展。

items.originalEnglish: I am supported through emotionally demanding work
items.workingChinese: 面对情绪负荷较高的工作时，我能得到支持。

items.originalEnglish: Relationships at work are strained
items.workingChinese: 工作中的人际关系紧张。

items.originalEnglish: My line manager encourages me at work
items.workingChinese: 直属主管在工作中鼓励我。

administration.instructionsZh: 工作条件会影响身心状态。以下问题帮助了解当前工作环境，并为后续改善提供线索。为便于比较，请根据过去六个月的工作经历作答。
administration.warning: 问的是工作条件，不是你是否抗压。参加应出于自愿；组织调查应保护匿名性，小群体不展示可能识别个人的结果。现系统匿名/小样本抑制未核验，不声称已实现。
administration.presentationChanges: Independent zhCN translation and digital presentation; not HSE certified survey, no logos or scoring colours copied.

presentationChanges: 保留原题顺序和逐题响应集。
指导语移入第一题之前，是明确记录的数字呈现调整，不声称原验证版式。
